batch: Revamp S3 Public, Intake and Organise: Phase A intake parity guard
kind: Test-only guard for the request as it works on main before the Wave 3 public home and /plan work
findingsNote: No gap is created or changed. No application code changed and no defect was found.
status: Built on branch revamp/public over main 49163d1. CI on the exact pushed head is the verifier; see the pull request for its result.
newFilesOnly: tests/integration/intake-parity.test.ts (vitest, no browser, no database, 50 tests)
tests/e2e/verification/ws-a/intake-parity.spec.ts (Playwright verification suite, 18 tests per width, 54 across w1280, w768 and w390)

pinned.jobs: All 15 mission jobs: key, label and criteria in catalogue order; objective a link sets, picture that opens it, and requirement role for each.
pinned.fieldsPerJob: Each job's own optional fields are shown and no other job's; every filled field leaves the browser in the structured request (specifications, quantity, unit, technical constraints, machinery application, organiser, participants, travel dates, decision criteria, budget).
pinned.originalCurrencies: Budget in BHD (3 places) and CNY (2 places) is sent in the currency's own smallest unit; 1.234 BHD gives 1234 and 12000.50 CNY gives 1200050; more decimals than the currency allows, comma separators and unknown currencies are refused.
pinned.validation: Quantity without a unit and a partial budget are refused on their own fields; offer, outcomes, website, name, company, market, timezone and visit window rules; the five steps cover every brief field.
pinned.consent: Sample and real schemas refuse an unacknowledged request; the form shows the acknowledgement error and sends nothing until it is ticked.
pinned.draftsAndResume: Guest draft survives a reload on the same step with its fields. Guided draft path: composeOffer keeps the customer's words, draftReadiness names plain gaps, draftProblems saving rules, draftCommandId is stable per draft version.
pinned.deepLinksAndOldUrls: /plan?job=<each of 15> selects the job; countries from the link are kept; /plan, an unknown job and an empty job leave no job chosen.
pinned.sentRequestIsStubbed: The browser spec answers POST /api/intake itself, so no request is stored and the hourly intake budget is untouched.

notPinned: The private account request path (/account/request) is a different page owned by S2; it shares the same Intake component and brief schema, and its sign-in flow is not exercised here.
The real-use pending and claim path (/api/intake/pending) is not exercised: the verification server runs without real use.

receipts.vitest: pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration/intake-parity.test.ts: exit 0, 50 passed (local, node 22).
receipts.playwright: pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.verification.config.ts tests/e2e/verification/ws-a/intake-parity.spec.ts on a local PostgreSQL 16 and a production build: 54 passed (2.8m) across the three widths.
